title: Dynamic behavior of molecular Pd-acetate trimers and dimers in heterogeneous vinyl acetate synthesis
core_idea: Investigate the mechanistic role and structural dynamics of molecular Pd-acetate trimers and dimers on Pd-based heterogeneous catalysts during gas-phase vinyl acetate synthesis (ethylene + acetic acid), using in situ and operando crystallographic and spectroscopic characterization combined with computational modeling on monometallic Pd model catalysts to clarify how these species influence catalyst behavior in KOAc-promoted systems.
tldr: Study aims to probe how molecular Pd-acetate trimers and dimers influence the mechanism and structural dynamics of heterogeneous vinyl acetate synthesis using in situ/operando experiments and computational modeling.
